interpretation.plain_speak: Using several past phases instead of one makes the probability estimate much better. Average mass error drops from about 23.8% to 7.9%. But the remaining error still alternates: phases 31 and 33 match each other while phase 32 is almost exact.
interpretation.north_star_question: Shows calibrated native risk is feasible in principle, but the remaining structured context drift must be explained by an internal state variable before using probabilities for cost-aware action.
interpretation.next_stage: use phase parity only as a diagnostic control—fit separate already-known even/odd calibration tables from phases26-30 and test on phases31-33—to determine whether the residual tracks a repeating context class; parity itself is not an acceptable deployment feature
